name: Adagia
description: Adagia, also called Adawa, is a windy world in Sothera that serves as the main base of the Sunstar Free Company.

summary.text: Adagia, also called Adawa, is a windy world in Sothera that serves as the main base of the Sunstar Free Company.

bio.text: Adagia is described as a windy world and the main base of the Sunstar Free Company, which has set up on it.
It is called the world of mirrors and is the Palatinate colony in Sothera.
It is Geldan's home world, where as a child she picked native flowers for pharmaceutical companies, and it has sandstorms and monsters.
It is also described as a Summist colony under mirrorscapes.

status.text: The latest story to mention it, Episode 9, describes it as a Summist colony under mirrorscapes.
